acceptance: Each of the 15 reports shows `metadata.llm_requested: true`, a non-zero count of successful LLM calls equal to the attempted count, and `analysis_completeness.is_complete: true`; a skill that fails this is rerun once, then listed by name as not analysed.

docs/skillspector-triage.md records, for every static and semantic finding: skill, rule, file and quoted text, the triage (real / declared purpose / false positive) and the reason; it names the scanner commit, the provider and the model taken from `llm_provenance`, and the scan date.

Every finding triaged as real in a catalog-owned skill is fixed by a commit that names the finding and the changed line; a rescan is supporting evidence only, and any new finding it shows is triaged too.
A real finding that cannot be fixed inside the frozen scope is recorded with `defer` and listed in the PR body.
The triage record says the semantic pass is rerun when a vendored skill is refreshed or the scanner pin is bumped.
